# `senate_disclosure_transactions`

**Senate reported transactions**

One row per native transaction within one electronic filing; amendments remain separate report observations.

**Coverage.** Sampled. A declared calendar filing year from the public Senate eFD PTR search. Electronic reports are qualified; listed paper reports remain unsupported observations. Annual reports are outside this selection. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

**Data quality.** Parent matches use literal listing names and report dates and may be ambiguous. No amendment replacement semantics, person enrichment or paper/annual completeness is inferred.

- **Parquet file:** `senate_disclosure_transactions.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `filing_year` | `INTEGER` | Calendar year selected by the publisher submission-date search; transaction dates may be outside it. |
| `report_id` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher UUID from the filing URL; amendments have their own UUID. |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Original public eFD report locator; using it may require the publisher agreement session. |
| `report_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of exact electronic report HTML. Null for unsupported paper observations. |
| `row_number` | `BIGINT` | Native transaction number, unique within this report. |
| `row_position` | `BIGINT` | One-based displayed row position; it may differ from the native transaction number. |
| `source_locator` | `VARCHAR` | CSS selector identifying this row in the exact retained HTML. |
| `transaction_date` | `DATE` | Valid calendar date from the printed transaction-date cell. |
| `transaction_date_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Original displayed slash-formatted transaction date. |
| `owner` | `VARCHAR` | Literal owner cell; an empty cell stays empty and is never assumed to mean Self. |
| `ticker` | `VARCHAR` | Printed ticker, with blank or double-dash markers represented as null; no external symbol enrichment. |
| `ticker_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Displayed ticker cell before missing-value interpretation. |
| `asset_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal asset-name text, including any source notes. |
| `asset_type` | `VARCHAR` | Literal asset-type label. |
| `transaction_type` | `VARCHAR` | Literal action, including Purchase, Sale (Full), Sale (Partial) or Exchange when printed. |
| `amount_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Exact displayed dollar range or other amount statement; no midpoint estimate. |
| `amount_lower_usd` | `BIGINT` | Lower printed dollar bound when recognized; null for an unresolved format. |
| `amount_upper_usd` | `BIGINT` | Upper printed dollar bound; null for an open upper bound or unresolved format. |
| `lower_inclusive` | `BOOLEAN` | Whether the recognized lower bound is inclusive; false for Over statements; null when unresolved. |
| `amount_parse_status` | `VARCHAR` | closed_range, open_upper or unresolved. Unknown text remains in amount_raw. |
| `comment` | `VARCHAR` | Printed comment with blank or double-dash markers represented as null. |
| `comment_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Displayed comment cell before missing-value interpretation. |
| `raw_cells_json` | `VARCHAR` | Every displayed transaction cell in source column order; raw source HTML is separately retained. |
